Manifest.Description: 进入垃圾场前在作业地图选择区域。包含区域掉落、拾荒客声望与解锁、储藏事件、搬运帮手、地面扩展及拾荒客开局。0.3.82 整理模块并修复掉落事件兼容、告示板和状态清理。 / Choose a region before entering the dump. Includes themed loot, scavenger reputation, stash events, hauling help, a larger sorting ground and a Scavenger start. 0.3.82 reorganizes modules and fixes event compatibility, loot notices and state cleanup.
